title: phyllanthus niruri subsp. lathyroides
intro: Phyllanthus niruri subsp. lathyroides, commonly known as Kidneyleaf or Chanca piedra, is a plant species that belongs to the family Phyllanthaceae. It is known for its potential health benefits, including the treatment of kidney stones, gallstones, and liver problems, as well as its ability to reduce inflammation and improve immune function. The therapeutic actions of Phyllanthus niruri subsp. lathyroides include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and diuretic properties, which may help to prevent the formation of kidney stones and alleviate symptoms associated with kidney disease. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which have been shown to exhibit hepatoprotective and nephroprotective effects, making it a potential natural remedy for various kidney and liver disorders.
